posts.text:
This older guy on Morning Joe was asked about a fake AI video showing a sports commentator being slapped and is like, “I hate that we can’t just enjoy a football game.”

Media: Please stop having clueless, out of touch people on to discuss misogyny and violence.
posts.summary: Criticizes media for platforming uninformed commentators on serious topics

posts.text:
This might be a dumb question but: Why can’t you train AI to…not kill people. Isn’t it bound by the rules it’s given? Like how does it become sentient and override clear instructions that it can’t do X,Y, or Z? 

(To be clear I think AI is net negative all around but just asking)
posts.summary: Expresses skepticism about AI safety and net societal benefit
